name: resend
description: Sends the site's email (sign-in links, form notifications, newsletters) through Resend's hosted email API. Ships the mail adapter itself (Tovu loads it only because Tovu shipped it) and the know-how to set it up: get a Resend API key, verify the sending domain, and save the key under Access Tokens with the exact label Tovu looks for.
author: Tovu
